ask-for-more-specific-information.label: Ask for More Specific Information
ask-for-more-specific-information.summary: Use the question forms Kilès, Kilè, and Poukisa to ask which, when, and why.

try_ask_for_more_specific_information_sk.title: Try it yourself: Choose the question form
try_ask_for_more_specific_information_sk.prompt: Right after the sketch "Kilès?", practice that exact idea with this task. Which form asks “which one?”. Produce the result for choose the question form so it reinforces Ask for More Specific Information.

try_ask_for_more_specific_information_sk.title: Try it yourself: Complete the when question
try_ask_for_more_specific_information_sk.prompt: Right after the sketch "Kilè?", practice that exact idea with this task. Choose The question form that completes the example. Produce the result for complete the when question so it reinforces Ask for More Specific Information.

try_ask_for_more_specific_information_sk.title: Try it yourself: Ask why
try_ask_for_more_specific_information_sk.prompt: Right after the sketch "Poukisa?", practice that exact idea with this task. Say the question “Why are you crying?” in Kreyòl. Produce the result for ask why so it reinforces Ask for More Specific Information.

specific-info-kiles-choice.title: Ask which one
specific-info-kiles-choice.prompt: Which form asks a person to choose one from a group?
specific-info-kiles-choice.hint: Think about the kind of information being requested.

help.concept: The target form asks for a selection among alternatives.
help.hint_1: Eliminate the forms that ask about time or reason.

specific-info-poukisa-choice.title: Ask for a reason
specific-info-poukisa-choice.prompt: Which form asks for a reason?
specific-info-poukisa-choice.hint: Think about what kind of answer would follow.

help.concept: A reason question expects an explanation of why something happens.
help.hint_1: Do not choose the form for selecting one item.
help.hint_2: Do not choose the form for asking when.

specific-info-kiles-fill.title: Complete the which question
specific-info-kiles-fill.hint: The sentence asks which one of a group.

help.hint_1: Compare the three new information goals.

specific-info-kile-fill.title: Complete the when question
specific-info-kile-fill.hint: The question asks about when someone will go.

help.hint_1: Compare the new question forms by meaning.
help.hint_2: Choose the form associated with when.

specific-info-kile-voice.title: Ask when
specific-info-kile-voice.prompt: Say the question “When will you go?” in Kreyòl.
specific-info-kile-voice.hint: Use the complete question from the lesson.

help.concept: This speaking task practices the new when-question as a complete expression.
help.hint_1: Begin with the new form for when.
help.hint_2: Then use the phrase ou prale.

specific-info-poukisa-voice.title: Ask why
specific-info-poukisa-voice.prompt: Say the question “Why are you crying?” in Kreyòl.
specific-info-poukisa-voice.hint: Use the complete question from the lesson.

help.concept: This speaking task practices a reason question as a complete expression.
help.hint_1: Begin with the new form for why.
help.hint_2: Then use the phrase ou ap kriye.

try-kiles-choice.title: Choose the question form
try-kiles-choice.hint: Compare the information requested by each form.

help.concept: One form asks a learner to select one from a group.
help.hint_1: Look for the form associated with choosing among alternatives.
help.hint_2: Do not choose the form for time or reason.

try-kile-fill.title: Complete the when question
try-kile-fill.prompt: Choose The question form that completes the example.
try-kile-fill.hint: The missing word asks for when something will happen.

help.concept: Choose the form that requests time information rather than a reason or a choice.
help.hint_1: Read the rest of the sentence before selecting the question word.
help.hint_2: The answer would tell when the person will go.

try-poukisa-voice.title: Ask why
try-poukisa-voice.prompt: Say the question “Why are you crying?” in Kreyòl.
try-poukisa-voice.hint: Use the complete question from this card.

help.hint_1: Begin with The form for why.
help.hint_2: Then keep the current-action phrase intact.

kiles-which.title: Kilès?
kiles-which.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Kilès?** to ask **which?**

For example:

**Kilès ladan yo?** — Which one of them?

Focus on **Kilès** as the new question for choosing one from a group.

kile-when.title: Kilè?
kile-when.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Kilè?** to ask **when?**

For example:

**Kilè ou prale?** — When will you go?

Use this question when you want to ask when something will happen.

poukisa-why.title: Poukisa?
poukisa-why.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Poukisa?** to ask **why?**

For example:

**Poukisa ou ap kriye?** — Why are you crying?

The reading section later uses the same form:

**Poukisa Kintola pa ale lekòl jodia?**

This topic focuses on the new information questions that extend what you learned in Course 1.
